title: Resources Manager
description:
**About the Role :**
The RMG Lead is a critical enabler of delivery excellence. You will own the resource management function end-to-end — ensuring seamless fulfilment of project demands, optimising workforce utilisation, and partnering with leadership to future-proof the organisation's talent supply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1/ Demand & Supply Management**

a/ Drive real-time visibility into open demands and available talent supply across all practices.

b/ Own the fulfilment lifecycle — from demand intake to deployment — including staffing, backfill, and internal mobility.

c/ Lead weekly and monthly resource review cadences with delivery managers and practice heads.

d/ Work closely with Talent Acquisition to bridge gaps that cannot be covered internally, and ensure SLA adherence on time-to-fill

**2/ Utilisation & Bench Management**

a/ Own billable utilisation targets at the practice and BU level.

b/ Proactively identify bench risks, track ageing, and build action plans to redeploy or upskill idle resources.

c/ Partner with Learning & Development and Practice to align skilling programs to the forward demand pipeline.

d/ Ensure bench employees are engaged, career-pathed, and deployment-ready.

**3/ Workforce Planning & Analytics**

a/ Translate headcount, skills, and project pipeline data into actionable hiring and workforce plans.

b/ Build and maintain dashboards and MIS reports covering utilisation, bench status, demand coverage, attrition, and headcount trends.

c/ Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**4/ Stakeholder Management**

a/ Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery managers, BU heads, project leads, and HR/TA for all resource-related matters.

b/ Balance competing priorities across stakeholders, negotiate trade-offs transparently, and manage expectations proactively.

c/ Build trust with bench employees by understanding their aspirations and advocating for their growth and transitions.

**5/ Governance, Process & Tools**

a/ Design and continuously refine RMG operating models, workflows, and SLAs.

b/ Ensure data accuracy and hygiene across resource management systems.

c/Champion internal mobility programs and cross-skilling initiatives as strategic levers for demand fulfilment.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of overall experience with at least 8 years in a Resource Management or Workforce Management role within an
  **500+ employee sized**
  IT services, consulting, or technology organisation.
* Deep familiarity with IT delivery models (Time & Material, Fixed Price, Managed Services) and their direct impact on resourcing strategy.
* Strong technical acumen and JD-reading and role-matching ability.
* Strong command of resource management and HRMS tools; advanced Excel skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to synthesise large workforce datasets into clear, actionable insights.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills — comfortable engaging VP/Director-level stakeholders.
* Track record of designing and executing internal mobility and bench utilisation programs.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; Bachelor's degree in any discipline is required

**Benefits:**

1/ High-visibility, high-impact position that sits at the crossroads of people strategy and business delivery.

2/ Direct line of sight to senior leadership, influence over how the organisation deploys its most important asset — its people

3/Fast growth trajectory for strong performers.

4/ Exposure to diverse technology domains and global clients.

5/ Competitive CTC, performance bonus, and health benefits.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Human Resources Executive | Zapplr Media Pvt Ltd | Kochi, Kerala (On-site, Monday to Saturday) | Full-time | 0–1 years**

Zapplr is one of South India's fastest-growing influencer marketing agencies, headquartered in Kochi. We run creator-led campaigns across Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada markets for brands, film studios, music labels and OTT platforms.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As our HR Executive, you'll own the day-to-day of everything people-related, from hiring great talent to keeping our team supported, organised and engaged. This is our first dedicated HR role. You won't inherit a rulebook; you'll help write it, with close guidance from leadership.

If you're early in your HR career and want variety, ownership and a front-row seat to how a modern agency is built, read on.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Talent acquisition

- Post and manage job openings across LinkedIn, Naukri and Indeed.

- Source, screen and shortlist candidates, and coordinate interviews.

- Manage the candidate pipeline in a simple tracker and roll out offers.

- Run reference checks and pre-joining formalities.

**Onboarding and people operations**

- Own onboarding so every new joiner has a smooth first week: documents, accounts, tools and induction.

- Track probation with 30/60/90-day check-ins and confirmations.

- Maintain employee records, documentation and HR trackers.

- Handle attendance, leave, payroll inputs and everyday employee queries.

- Manage exit and offboarding formalities, including exit interviews.

**Performance and engagement**

- Coordinate performance reviews: timelines, forms, follow-ups and records.

- Track goals and check-ins, and flag issues to leadership early.

- Run engagement activities, celebrations and team initiatives.

- Be the team's first point of contact on people matters.

**Building the HR function**

- Help draft the employee handbook and core policies (leave, attendance, conduct, POSH) with leadership.

- Create standard templates: offer letters, appointment letters and review forms.

- Help select and set up an HRMS or attendance tool.

- Assist with basic HR compliance, working with our CA and consultants.

- Share a short monthly HR update: open roles, joiners, exits and attendance.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

- A degree in HR, Management, Psychology or a related field (MBA-HR is a plus, not a requirement).

- 0–1 years of experience, or strong internships in HR or recruiting.

- Excellent communication in English and Malayalam (Tamil, Telugu or Kannada a bonus).

- Strong organisation, follow-through and attention to detail.

- Comfort with Google Workspace and Sheets, and a willingness to learn HR tools.

- Discretion and maturity with confidential information.

- A genuine interest in people and in building something from the ground up.

- Able to work from our Kochi office Monday to Saturday.

**NICE TO HAVE**

- Exposure to a startup, agency or media/creative environment.

- Familiarity with ATS platforms or job-board hiring.

- Basic understanding of HR compliance and Indian labour norms.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**

- Days 1–30: Learn the team and current practices, build the employee database, and take over open hiring.

- Days 31–60: Roll out the onboarding checklist, offer and appointment templates, and attendance and leave tracking.

- Days 61–90: Draft the employee handbook with leadership, run the first review cycle, and share the first monthly HR update.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

- A first-hire role with real ownership and direct access to the founder.

- The chance to build an HR function from scratch as we scale.

- A young, creative, fast-moving team in the influencer marketing space.

- Room to grow into a senior people role over time.

Zapplr Media is an equal opportunity employer.
